'''Checkpoint Alpha''' was a staging area the soon to become [[501st Legion/Legends|501st Legion]] set up near a downed [[Hardcell-class interstellar transport/Legends|Techno Union ship]] during the [[First Battle of Geonosis/Legends|Battle of Geonosis]]. The [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] deployed [[Medical droid/Legends|medical]] and [[Power droid/Legends|ammo droids]] near the area to help with the battle. When a [[Clone jet trooper/Legends|Clone jet trooper]] found a valuable [[Unidentified holocron|holocron]] dropped by a [[Death/Legends|dead]] [[Geonosian/Legends|Geonosian]], he was ordered by his superiors to drop it off at Checkpoint Alpha.
